_comment: Single source of truth for the careers page. scripts/sync-careers.mjs projects this onto careers.html, ms/careers.html and zh/careers.html: the open-roles counter, the hiring sentence, each role card's action button, the online application form, and JobPosting structured data. Nothing on the page is hand-counted any more - add a slug to `open` and the page follows.

roleMeta._comment: Required only once a slug is listed in `open`. JobPosting is emitted only for open roles that carry complete meta, so the page can never publish an incomplete posting.

system-analyst.description: Translate business requirements into clear system specifications and delivery-ready plans.

en.openNote: We are hiring for the roles below. Applications are reviewed within one business day.
en.closedNote: We are not actively hiring right now. The roles below are the capabilities we commonly need. As openings arise we update them here — and we always welcome thoughtful open applications.
en.formLead: Send your CV and a short note. Everything goes straight to our hiring inbox.

en.errorNote: Could not send the application right now. Please email hr@phisoft.my instead.
en.mailtoFallback: Prefer email? Send your CV to hr@phisoft.my

ms.openNote: Kami sedang mengambil pekerja untuk peranan di bawah. Permohonan disemak dalam masa satu hari bekerja.
